about: Dev-only fixture vaults, served when NEXT_PUBLIC_VAULTS_SAMPLE=1 in development. Each entry holds the UI metadata, the vault and its cycles in the HTTP API shapes (amounts are base-unit strings, newest cycle first) and the wallet position. Timestamps were written against `anchor` and are shifted to the current time when loaded. `pricesUsd` holds a USD price per deposit asset, used for TVL in dollars.

meta.name: USDC
meta.description: Sells weekly puts secured by deposited USDC.
